title: objectql: uninstallPackage, disablePackage and enablePackage never ask the record-currency follow door, so a disabled supplier extension or a re-enabled bad extension can leave a following amount served without judgment
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

Follow-up of #33593 / PR #33621 (area E2b, area-lease pilot #33059). The seat filed this unleased during the pilot drain.

## Premise (read from code by E2b's os-dev, not measured)
`uninstallPackage`, `disablePackage` and `enablePackage` never ask the record-currency follow door (the R1–R7 rules of #33593).
- Disabling or uninstalling a supplier extension can leave a following amount served against a parent that has no code field.
- Enabling a package can bring back a bad extension amount without judging it.

## Step 1
Measure each of the three doors with a supplier extension and a following amount.

## Step 2
If it reproduces, judge the served fold at each door under #33593's rules. Disable or uninstall is refused when it would leave a bad pair served, naming the package and field. Enable is refused when it would complete a bad pair. Clause-② table, contract review. The seat rules if the measurement shows a different shape.

Dedupe words: record-currency follow door disable supplier extension; enablePackage follow pair; uninstall supplier code field.
